versions.changelog:
- Added "Start on APIDot" section highlighting key APIDot entry points for ClawHub users.
- Minor wording improvements and clarifications throughout SKILL.md.
- Removed file: skill-card.md.

- Added non-executable API reference notes in references/api.md to supplement model routing and workflow guidance.
- Removed skill-card.md as part of file cleanup.
- Updated SKILL.md to include the new references/api.md file and clarify that this release contains both SKILL.md and reference notes, not just SKILL.md.
- No changes to executable code; documentation and guidance only.

apidot-flux-2-api v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces documentation-only guidance for integrating APIDot FLUX.2 API workflows.
- Covers text-to-image, image editing, multi-reference workflows, async task submission, polling, and webhook integration.
- Includes security rules for API key handling and best practices for production use.
- Offers model routing advice and direct links to APIDot docs, model pages, and examples.
- No executable scripts, network calls, or bundled API clients included in this version.
